key: SUSPICIOUS MAN: All right. Let's liberate the Pokémon and escape quickly.
en: SUSPICIOUS MAN: All right. Let's liberate the Pokémon and escape quickly.
ja: あやしい男: よし。ポケモンを解放して　さっさと逃げるぞ

key: SUSPICIOUS WOMAN: Understood.
en: SUSPICIOUS WOMAN: Understood.
ja: あやしい女: 了解

key: SUSPICIOUS MAN: If this woman figures out we're targeting her, she's sure to flee Reborn.
en: SUSPICIOUS MAN: If this woman figures out we're targeting her, she's sure to flee Reborn.
ja: あやしい男: 狙われていると気づかれたら　あの女は　必ずリボーンから逃げる

key: That's one more--
en: That's one more--
ja: これで　もう一匹――

key: SUSPICIOUS WOMAN: We've been found!
en: SUSPICIOUS WOMAN: We've been found!
ja: あやしい女: 見つかった!

key: SUSPICIOUS MAN: It's of no consequence. There's no way to know where we're headed.
en: SUSPICIOUS MAN: It's of no consequence. There's no way to know where we're headed.
ja: あやしい男: 問題ない。行き先を　知られる心配はない

key: Hey kid, stay out of our business if you know what's good for you.
en: Hey kid, stay out of our business if you know what's good for you.
ja: おいガキ　身のためだ　オレたちに関わるな

key: OFFICER: Hold it right there.
en: OFFICER: Hold it right there.
ja: 警官: そこまでだ

key: This is a private space. How did you get in here?
en: This is a private space. How did you get in here?
ja: ここは　関係者以外　立ち入り禁止だ。どうやって入った?

key: ???: Ah, that would be because you left the door unlocked.
en: ???: Ah, that would be because you left the door unlocked.
ja: ???: ああ　それは　あなたが　カギをかけ忘れていたからです

key: Please be more careful of that in the future, too!
en: Please be more careful of that in the future, too!
ja: 今後は　もっと気をつけてくださいね!

key: OFFICER: Hmph. Then I guess for now, I just gotta deal with this suspicious person.
en: OFFICER: Hmph. Then I guess for now, I just gotta deal with this suspicious person.
ja: 警官: ふん。ならば今は　この不審者を　どうにかするだけだ

key: I'll start by searching you.
en: I'll start by searching you.
ja: まずは　身体検査からだ

key: Aha! What's this?!
en: Aha! What's this?!
ja: おっ! これは何だ!?

key: It's the information that was stolen!
en: It's the information that was stolen!
ja: 盗まれた情報じゃないか!

key: And the thief wandered right back here!
en: And the thief wandered right back here!
ja: しかも　盗人が　自分から戻ってくるとはな!

key: Maybe it was a good thing the door was open.
en: Maybe it was a good thing the door was open.
ja: カギが開いていたのも　よかったのかもしれん

key: ???: So one mistake solves another! Interesting.
en: ???: So one mistake solves another! Interesting.
ja: ???: ひとつのミスが　別のミスを解決する! 興味深い

key: OFFICER: And for the theft of confidential documents, you're under arrest!
en: OFFICER: And for the theft of confidential documents, you're under arrest!
ja: 警官: 機密文書を盗んだ罪で　お前を逮捕する!

key: ...Uh, sir?
en: ...Uh, sir?
ja: ……あの　隊長?

key: ???: Seer.
en: ???: Seer.
ja: ???: シーア

key: SEER: Yes, sir?
en: SEER: Yes, sir?
ja: シーア: はい　隊長

key: ???: I see that you are skilled at acting without hesitation! This is a merit.
en: ???: I see that you are skilled at acting without hesitation! This is a merit.
ja: ???: キミは　ためらわず行動できるようだな! それは　長所である

key: But, however! You must also learn to fully understand a situation before rushing into it.
en: But, however! You must also learn to fully understand a situation before rushing into it.
ja: しかし　だが! 飛びこむ前に　状況を　しっかりつかむことも　学ばねばならん

key: ???: Please pardon my junior's hastiness.
en: ???: Please pardon my junior's hastiness.
ja: ???: 後輩の早とちりを　許してほしい

key: You see, we're with the International Police.
en: You see, we're with the International Police.
ja: ワタシたちは　国際警察の者だ

key: My name... Ah, no. I shall only inform you of my code name. It is Looker.
en: My name... Ah, no. I shall only inform you of my code name. It is Looker.
ja: ワタシの名は……いや　コードネームだけ　伝えよう。ハンサムだ

key: We've come to Reborn after hearing about a certain organization that might be harming Pokémon.
en: We've come to Reborn after hearing about a certain organization that might be harming Pokémon.
ja: ポケモンを害している組織のうわさを聞いて　リボーンに来た

key: My partner here is still in training, so we may not be much help in the end. Nevertheless!
en: My partner here is still in training, so we may not be much help in the end. Nevertheless!
ja: 相棒は　まだ訓練中でな　力になれないかもしれん。それでも!

key: SEER: Sorry, sir.
en: SEER: Sorry, sir.
ja: シーア: すみません　隊長

key: LOOKER: Ah, but if you can learn to think like a detective, there will be no need for apologies!
en: LOOKER: Ah, but if you can learn to think like a detective, there will be no need for apologies!
ja: ハンサム: なに　探偵のように考えられるようになれば　あやまる必要などない!

key: At any rate! Let us have--
en: At any rate! Let us have--
ja: ともあれ! では――

key: Pardon me! I seem to have forgotten my manners. What is your name?
en: Pardon me! I seem to have forgotten my manners.  What is your name?
ja: 失礼! 礼儀を忘れていたようだ。キミの名は?

key: Indeed! Well, let us have \PN tell us how they came to have the stolen information.
en: Indeed! Well, let us have \PN tell us how they came to have the stolen information.
ja: なるほど! では \PN　盗まれた情報を　どうやって手に入れたか　話してくれ

key: I see, so somebody else found it and gave it to you. Interesting, interesting...
en: I see, so somebody else found it and gave it to you.  Interesting, interesting...
ja: なるほど　誰かが見つけて　キミに渡したと。興味深い　実に興味深い……

key: SEER: Are you sure we can believe something like that?
en: SEER: Are you sure we can believe something like that?
ja: シーア: そんな話　信じていいんですか?

key: LOOKER: That's true. You're on alert for any red herrings! This is good!
en: LOOKER: That's true. You're on alert for any red herrings! This is good!
ja: ハンサム: たしかにな。にせの手がかりを　警戒しているのだな! よろしい!

key: However, I do not think they are lying.
en: However, I do not think they are lying.
ja: だが　ウソをついているとは思えん

key: Somehow, they remind me of a certain other Trainer...
en: Somehow, they remind me of a certain other Trainer...
ja: どこか　あるトレーナーを　思い出させる……

key: No, not even just one.
en: No, not even just one.
ja: いや　一人だけではないな

key: I believe \PN can be trusted.
en: I believe \PN can be trusted.
ja: \PNは　信用できると　ワタシは思う

key: And anyway, they are returning the information, are they not?
en: And anyway, they are returning the information, are they not?
ja: それに　情報を返してくれるのだろう?

key: \PN handed over Confidential Information.
en: \PN handed over Confidential Information.
ja: \PNは　きみつじょうほうを　わたした!

key: LOOKER: And it's still sealed!
en: LOOKER: And it's still sealed!
ja: ハンサム: しかも　封は　そのままだ!

key: There is nothing to worry about now.
en: There is nothing to worry about now.
ja: もう　心配はいらん

key: \PN, thank you for your assistance.
en: \PN, thank you for your assistance.
ja: \PN　協力に感謝する

key: SEER: It was my mistake that led to us losing that. I'll take full responsibility!
en: SEER: It was my mistake that led to us losing that. I'll take full responsibility!
ja: シーア: なくしたのは　わたしのミスです。責任は　すべて取ります!

key: SEER: During my search for those files, I found that instead.
en: SEER: During my search for those files, I found that instead.
ja: シーア: 書類を探している間に　代わりに　これを見つけました

key: I'm not sure if it's valuable, but hopefully it can serve as my apology.
en: I'm not sure if it's valuable, but hopefully it can serve as my apology.
ja: 価値があるかは　分かりませんが　おわびの印になれば

key: LOOKER: Then it's all but settled!
en: LOOKER: Then it's all but settled!
ja: ハンサム: では　これで　ほぼ解決だな!

key: My partner and I must be back to work!
en: My partner and I must be back to work!
ja: ワタシと相棒は　仕事に戻らねば!

key: However, there is much to be learned. So our work may be slow.
en: However, there is much to be learned. So our work may be slow.
ja: だが　学ぶことは多い。仕事は　遅くなるかもしれん

key: In any case!
en: In any case!
ja: ともあれ!

key: It has been a pleasure to meet you, \PN. But we must bid farewell.
en: It has been a pleasure to meet you, \PN. But we must bid farewell.
ja: 会えてよかった \PN。だが　ここで　お別れだ

key: Perhaps we will see each other again!
en: Perhaps we will see each other again!
ja: また　会うこともあるだろう!
